quality.review_scope: Independent R3 audit of all four supplied main pages, Figures 1–4 and the 29-entry bibliography passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete four-page main read, including Figures 1–4 and references 1–29. Binary local SI remains outside screened-pass scope and was not read; cited full sources unreviewed.

The quantified noble-metal procedure uses 20 mL aqueous salt solution, an example 0.5 g salt charge, 1.6 g sodium linoleate, 10 mL ethanol, 2 mL linoleic acid, a 40 mL autoclave and 10 h. Generic soluble-chloride identities/oxidation states/hydration are not resolved for Ru/Rh/Ir/Pd/Pt; HAuCl4 hydration also unreported.
Named Figure 1 temperatures/sizes are separate from general material-family temperature and size ranges. Ranges do not create independent experiments; physical batch/aliquot overlap is unspecified.

Non-noble examples retain only their explicit caption charges, ratios and temperatures. The noble-metal 0.5 g, common liquid charges and 10 h are not transferred to them. Metal counterions, anion-source alternatives, pressure, duration and workup often remain unreported.
Caption CoFe2O4 uses Co2+:Fe2+=1:2. This literal oxidation-state wording is retained, without chemically correcting it. Figure 2 shows CdS, not the Figure 1 CdSe TEM sample.
Scale bars and XRD peak indices are not particle means or refined cell coordinates. General size-tuning, fluorescence and storage statements are not per-specimen numerical property measurements.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending. No measured coordinates or complete lab SOP is asserted.
